name: Search Jira Issues via JQL
description: Searches for Jira issues using JQL (Jira Query Language). Returns issue keys, summaries, statuses, assignees, and other fields. Handles pagination automatically.

jiraCloudId.description: Jira Cloud site ID (UUID). Get it via the Get Sites action.

jql.description: JQL query string. Must be bounded (include a search restriction). Examples: 'project = ENG AND status = Open', 'assignee = currentUser() ORDER BY updated DESC'

fields.description: Comma-separated field list. Use '*all' for all fields, '*navigable' for navigable fields.

nextPageToken.description: Pagination token from a previous response
